method: Human audit of the agent's FIRST-PASS answers on a stratified 15-app sample. Each field was marked right/wrong/unsure against the real docs. For wrong fields: values already fixed by verification loops count as 'pre-fixed'; otherwise the auditor's documented correction was applied. 'After' counts pre-fixed + auditor-corrected values as correct (auditor correction treated as ground truth); unresolved wrong values stay wrong. Fields the human called right but verification had changed are listed as conflicts, with the verified value kept.
